privacy.redaction_policy: Only sanitized command names, exit codes, and root-cause summaries are recorded.

summary.wl3_master2_batch: 2026-08-11: ERR-024..ERR-036 local repairs; ERR-037..ERR-042 workspace discovery, dashboard contract drift, tauri toolchain, CI freshness

errors.observed_error: Referenced root governance files and validators were missing.
errors.root_cause: The test contract was added before all referenced governance artifacts were created.
errors.fix: Created the module dependency, project data boundary, supply-chain artifacts and validators.
errors.repeat_prevention: Root tests must check referenced file existence before behavior assertions; the root gate must run after artifact creation.
errors.remaining_boundary: Cloud CI was not run.

errors.observed_error: The combined test invocation failed without isolating the failing test boundary.
errors.root_cause: A broad command was used before splitting the failure by module and contract layer.
errors.fix: Ran Task Ledger, Observer, Client Neutral Manifest and core-schema tests as separate focused commands, then reran discovery.
errors.repeat_prevention: When an aggregate test fails, the workflow must preserve the original output and automatically split by test file before changing code.
errors.remaining_boundary: The aggregate result is local evidence, not cloud CI evidence.

errors.observed_error: CORE_SCHEMA_CONTRACT_FAIL: forbidden key token in task-ledger schema.
errors.root_cause: The budget field name collided with the global sensitive-key denylist.
errors.fix: Renamed the budget field to tokens across the Ledger implementation, schema, tests and verifier expectations.
errors.repeat_prevention: Scan new schema keys against the global denylist before implementation and require positive/negative schema controls.
errors.remaining_boundary: No live provider or runtime state was inspected.

errors.observed_error: Tests referenced a production export that did not yet exist; one sensitive-key assertion also used the wrong case.
errors.root_cause: The test contract was written without first confirming the production export and exact runtime error text.
errors.fix: Added the production analytics schema/sink export and corrected the case-sensitive assertion.
errors.repeat_prevention: Before adding a test, the author must resolve the production symbol and call path; assertions must use observed behavior rather than guessed spelling.
errors.remaining_boundary: Real platform analytics was not exercised.

errors.observed_error: The historical verifier path did not exist in the current repository.
errors.root_cause: An outdated task instruction was executed without checking the current filesystem and supported V3 entrypoints.
errors.fix: Enumerated real files and switched to verify_product_manifest_v3.py, verify_runtime_contracts_v3.py, verify_visual_scoring_v3.py and verify_visual_quality_v21.py.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every command must pass an entrypoint preflight: exact file exists, current working directory, help/arguments and module owner.
errors.remaining_boundary: Live Open Design E3 registration remains pending.

errors.observed_error: The restoration command ran under the wrong working directory and returned pathspec errors.
errors.root_cause: The test command's nested workdir was assumed to persist for a root-relative recovery command; the original test exit code also masked the recovery failure.
errors.fix: Checked pwd and root git status, reran git restore from WORK-LAB root, and verified module status plus diff check separately.
errors.repeat_prevention: Recovery commands must independently check their exit code and run from an explicitly verified repository root; never use a final exit-code variable that hides cleanup failure.
errors.remaining_boundary: No generated-file recovery is evidence of a release build.

errors.observed_error: Task counts were manually updated at different times and could drift from per-task states; the final Ledger fingerprint edit also occurred after the last full suite.
errors.root_cause: Evidence summaries were treated as authoritative instead of being derived from the canonical task map and final-tree verification.
errors.fix: Added this canonical error ledger and required machine validation of fields, counts, evidence levels and remaining boundaries.
errors.repeat_prevention: The workflow must recompute counts from task_status, must run a narrow regression after every post-suite edit, and must rerun the affected full gate before updating the baseline.
errors.remaining_boundary: The fingerprint focused test and affected full Workflow suite now pass; cloud CI and Git delivery remain separate boundaries.

errors.observed_error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named test_workflow_governance.
errors.root_cause: The tests directory is not a Python package, so module-name unittest loading is not a supported entrypoint.
errors.fix: Used file-based discovery from the module root: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_workflow_governance.py.
errors.repeat_prevention: Focused Python tests in non-package directories must use file-based discovery or direct file execution; module-name loading must not be used without package markers.
errors.remaining_boundary: This validates the local test entrypoint only; it does not prove cloud CI.

errors.observed_error: dataclasses import failed with NoneType.__dict__ during direct importlib loading.
errors.root_cause: The focused test loader did not register the dynamically created module in sys.modules before execution.
errors.fix: Registered the module under spec.name before calling exec_module.
errors.repeat_prevention: Dynamic import tests must register the module in sys.modules before executing code that introspects __module__.
errors.remaining_boundary: The conformance adapter is an isolated fake and does not prove a real client adapter.

errors.observed_error: VERIFY_ORDER contained adapter-conformance but the test tuple expected the previous gate sequence.
errors.root_cause: Adding a canonical gate changed the production order without synchronizing the governance assertion.
errors.fix: Updated the expected VERIFY_ORDER tuple to include adapter-conformance.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every new quality gate must update the runner, VERIFY_ORDER, root workflow wiring and order assertions together.
errors.remaining_boundary: The local full suite does not prove a remote GitHub Actions run.

errors.observed_error: run_quality_gate list output included adapter-conformance but the expected output substring did not.
errors.root_cause: The human-readable gate listing assertion was not synchronized with the newly canonical gate.
errors.fix: Updated the expected gate listing substring to include adapter-conformance.
errors.repeat_prevention: Gate additions require updating both machine order assertions and rendered list assertions.
errors.remaining_boundary: The rendered list is local contract evidence, not CI execution evidence.

errors.observed_error: The verifier was invoked from the Workflow module directory and the relative root script path did not exist.
errors.root_cause: The command workdir was not aligned with the repository-root entrypoint.
errors.fix: Reran the same verifier from WORK-LAB root after confirming the exact path.
errors.repeat_prevention: Root-level CI verifiers must run from an explicitly verified repository root or use an absolute path.
errors.remaining_boundary: This verifies the local error ledger only; it does not prove the root GitHub job executed.

errors.observed_error: MODULE_DEPENDENCIES_FAIL modules must exactly match the three canonical modules.
errors.root_cause: The v1 verifier hard-coded minigame as an active module and rejected the v2 Observer module and observed-by relation.
errors.fix: Updated canonical module IDs, path classifier, dependency types, and root tests for work-lab-observer; legacy minigame remains archive-only.
errors.repeat_prevention: Active module registries must derive from the current task-pack architecture and reject retired product trees as active modules.
errors.remaining_boundary: No live Observer or Tauri runtime was executed.

errors.observed_error: CONTRACT_CATALOG_FAIL visual-qa-report: schema $id is required.
errors.root_cause: The reused visual-quality schema predated the v2 catalog requirement for canonical schema IDs.
errors.fix: Added the canonical work-lab/visual-qa-report/v1 $id without creating a second visual QA schema.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every schema added to the catalog must be checked for JSON Schema validity and a non-empty canonical $id.
errors.remaining_boundary: Schema validation does not prove live cross-module producer/consumer traffic.

errors.observed_error: The manifest test expected 10 schemas while the v2 Workflow manifest declared 13.
errors.root_cause: The production schema registry was expanded before the legacy exact-count assertion was synchronized.
errors.fix: Updated the test to assert the v2 core schema count of 13 and reran the full Workflow suite.
errors.repeat_prevention: Schema additions must update production manifest, verifier expectations, tests, and root catalog in one change set.
errors.remaining_boundary: The full result is local evidence; remote CI remains unrun.

errors.observed_error: Remote checkout could not find the ignored local error ledger required by the integration gate.
errors.root_cause: The verifier consumed a .hermes task artifact that is intentionally not version controlled, so fresh CI had no canonical input.
errors.fix: Moved the sanitized canonical ledger to 50-taskpacks/error-ledger.json and changed the verifier to use the tracked path; the ignored artifact remains local evidence only.
errors.repeat_prevention: Canonical CI inputs must be tracked or explicitly provisioned; never require an ignored runtime artifact in a fresh checkout.
errors.remaining_boundary: The next exact-SHA CI run must verify the repaired integration and aggregate jobs.

errors.observed_error: Remote aggregate reported missing_or_failed minigame after workflow, open-design, observer and integration all succeeded.
errors.root_cause: The v1 aggregate gate still required the retired minigame job instead of the v2 observer job.
errors.fix: Changed the canonical required job set to workflow, open-design, observer and integration and added positive/negative regression tests.
errors.repeat_prevention: Any module job rename must update the aggregate required set, workflow payload, root tests and exact-SHA CI readback together.
errors.remaining_boundary: A new exact-SHA CI run must confirm aggregate success after this fix.

errors.observed_error: CURRENT_STATE_FRESHNESS_FAIL git-head tracked=... actual=... (old branch/head could pass)
errors.root_cause: Freshness check excluded git identity and CI evidence; tracked CURRENT_STATE could contain stale branch/head/CI and still pass
errors.fix: Added head_tree/remote_main readback, git-identity ancestor check, CI-evidence default fallback, and tracked-head tree consistency check
errors.repeat_prevention: Freshness gate must reject stale git/CI unconditionally; CI requires fetch-depth 0
errors.remaining_boundary: PR merge-ref ancestor semantics requires fetch-depth 0 in CI

errors.command: git push origin feat/wl3-master-2.0-local-implementation (verify workflow parse)
errors.observed_error: This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue (0 jobs created)
errors.root_cause: defaults.run.env.PYTHONPATH value contained unquoted colons/path separators that GitHub's YAML parser interpreted as nested mapping
errors.fix: Moved PYTHONPATH to job-level env with quoted value; removed defaults.run.env entirely
errors.regression_test: CI exact-SHA run on PR head
errors.repeat_prevention: Job-level env must be used; defaults.run.env must never carry unquoted path values
errors.remaining_boundary: None

errors.observed_error: CURRENT_STATE_FRESHNESS_FAIL git-head tracked not an ancestor of HEAD
errors.root_cause: workflow-assistance job checkout used shallow clone (default fetch-depth 1); merge-base --is-ancestor needs full history
errors.fix: Added fetch-depth: 0 to workflow-assistance job checkout
errors.regression_test: CI exact-SHA run on PR head
errors.repeat_prevention: All freshness-checking CI jobs must use fetch-depth 0
errors.remaining_boundary: None

errors.command: python -m unittest test_growth_watcher_collector (verify worker trigger chain)
errors.observed_error: Growth watcher was offline-only; no trigger chain into the durable worker
errors.root_cause: WL3-300 required watcher triggers (on-start/on-task-complete/schedule); growth_watcher existed but was not wired into build_standard_collectors
errors.fix: Added collect_growth_watcher as fifth standard collector; records discovered candidates via growth pipeline state machine (no auto-promotion)
errors.repeat_prevention: Watcher must stay wired in build_standard_collectors; gate must register its test
errors.remaining_boundary: Live promotion still requires explicit approval

errors.observed_error: test_stage3_baseline asserted old taskpackId and dirty count 13; test_current_state asserted dirty count 13
errors.root_cause: Baseline and CURRENT_STATE were regenerated for Master 2.0 (28 tasks, dirty=5) but test expectations were not updated
errors.fix: Updated assertions to WORK-LAB-FINAL-MASTER-CONTROL-PLANE, dirty count 5, incomingCandidateSourceDigest
errors.repeat_prevention: Baseline regeneration must require test-assertion sync
errors.remaining_boundary: None

errors.observed_error: UNIQUE constraint failed: telemetry_events.event_id (duplicate timestamps)
errors.root_cause: Event IDs derived from _now() timestamps collide within same tick; collector wrote to store AND worker wrote again
errors.fix: UUID-suffixed event IDs; collectors return records and worker is the single writer
errors.repeat_prevention: Single-writer contract must be enforced; event IDs must use UUID suffix
errors.remaining_boundary: None

errors.observed_error: A tracked current-state file could pass while its embedded checkout and CI identity was already one commit stale.
errors.root_cause: A commit cannot truthfully contain its own final SHA, and accepting an ancestor only hid the recursive identity problem.
errors.fix: Changed tracked state to a no-identity projection and moved checkout, tree, writer, dirty-state and exact-CI binding to ignored runtime attestation.
errors.repeat_prevention: Tracked projections must never embed their containing commit identity; every exact checkout claim requires fresh runtime attestation.
errors.remaining_boundary: Remote main exact-SHA CI evidence is not available for this local tree.

errors.observed_error: The v2 ownership registry, v1 JSON Schema and legacy repo-to-live merge recipe made conflicting authority claims.
errors.root_cause: The registry was upgraded without upgrading the schema or retiring the legacy live-deployment wording.
errors.fix: Made the v2 registry authoritative, upgraded its schema and constrained the legacy recipe to isolated empty-home compatibility.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every ownership change must update registry, schema, verifier and legacy-authority negative control together.
errors.remaining_boundary: No global live configuration was applied.

errors.observed_error: Sidecar snapshots read JSON/JSONL ledgers and the SSE response ended immediately with Content-Length.
errors.root_cause: The canonical SQLite and in-memory SSE hub foundations were implemented but never connected to the HTTP sidecar.
errors.fix: Projected canonical SQLite directly and implemented a persistent loopback SSE stream with replay, heartbeat and bounded subscribers.
errors.repeat_prevention: The sidecar must use canonical SQLite only and every SSE regression must prove a new event arrives on the same open connection.
errors.remaining_boundary: Long-duration real desktop soak testing remains pending.

errors.observed_error: Observer still wrote observer-events.jsonl and opened the canonical database through a migrating read-write constructor.
errors.root_cause: A read-only wrapper was added around a writable store instead of removing the second business ledger and write-capable connection.
errors.fix: Retired Observer append, added SQLite mode=ro, and made the dashboard read Workflow canonical SQLite directly without creating runtime paths.
errors.repeat_prevention: Observer tests must assert database timestamps and runtime paths remain unchanged after every GET.
errors.remaining_boundary: Tauri desktop packaging was not launched in this environment.

errors.observed_error: Approved adapter plans returned APPLIED and rollback returned success although neither operation changed or restored anything.
errors.root_cause: Conformance checked only for a status string and mistook approval gating for a real implementation.
errors.fix: Declared the implemented read-only operations and return UNSUPPORTED for mutation and invocation until official implementations exist.
errors.repeat_prevention: Conformance must reject success for every operation absent from advertised capabilities; approval must never substitute for implementation.
errors.remaining_boundary: Live adapter apply remains unsupported and requires separate implementation and approval.

errors.observed_error: The suite emitted many downstream errors before revealing that the JSON Schema validator dependency was missing.
errors.root_cause: There was no checked-in dependency file or fail-fast preflight, and the module workflow installed only one validator dependency.
errors.fix: Added requirements.txt, installed it in both workflows and added a single fail-fast dependency diagnostic.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every quality-gate entrypoint must run dependency preflight before collecting or executing tests.
errors.remaining_boundary: This sandbox intentionally did not install missing global dependencies.

errors.entrypoint: Observer projection and web mode selection
errors.observed_error: Missing usage and CI sources were rendered as zero, unknown projects were promoted to running and every successful GET was labelled LIVE.
errors.root_cause: Fallback defaults encoded display convenience as factual evidence and the frontend ignored the server projection mode.
errors.fix: Represented unknown metrics as null, preserved unknown task state and made the frontend honor LIVE, SNAPSHOT, OFFLINE and UNKNOWN modes.
errors.repeat_prevention: Unknown values must never be normalized to zero, running, exact, complete or LIVE without source evidence.
errors.remaining_boundary: Real multi-project canary data is still required before LIVE product claims.

errors.observed_error: Selecting a target immediately mutated the global Hermes model route without a separate plan/apply approval gate.
errors.root_cause: The switcher had field readback and rollback but predated the control-plane ActionPlan contract and treated invocation as approval.
errors.fix: Made every switch plan-only by default, required --apply --approved, capability-detected official get/set/unset, used unset for absent-field rollback, and kept paid live smoke separately explicit.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every global config writer must default to a schema-valid ActionPlan and must prove stable read, write, readback and inverse operations before the first mutation.
errors.remaining_boundary: No global Hermes configuration or paid live smoke was applied in this audit.

errors.observed_error: The client-neutral core manifest and CI pinned a Hermes package/config version and default verify required that optional runtime.
errors.root_cause: A historical portable compatibility snapshot was promoted into the permanent core dependency contract.
errors.fix: Replaced Agent/config version ranges with capability discovery, removed Hermes installation from core CI, and kept portable-install-runtime as an explicit optional gate.
errors.repeat_prevention: Core manifests and CI must never pin or install a replaceable Agent solely to make an optional Adapter gate pass.
errors.remaining_boundary: A real Hermes runtime compatibility check remains optional and requires an already-discovered installation.

errors.entrypoint: Hermes route diagnostics and Observer/Sidecar service entrypoints
errors.observed_error: Production diagnostics guessed local router ports and formal loopback services used fixed default ports.
errors.root_cause: Historical workstation defaults were encoded as product capabilities instead of being discovered or advertised.
errors.fix: Removed guessed router probes, used declared proxy environment, bound Sidecar/Observer to OS-assigned ports, advertised actual endpoints, and removed the frontend fixed-port fallback.
errors.regression_test: python tests/test_sidecar.py and python tests/test_observer_dashboard.py and node tests/run_all_tests.js
errors.repeat_prevention: Runtime clients must discover an advertised endpoint and must never infer service availability from a repository-fixed port.
errors.remaining_boundary: Tauri dynamic dashboard endpoint injection remains pending; until then it degrades to a labelled non-live snapshot.

errors.observed_error: The dual-project canary searched a fixed set of workstation paths and could miss or misclassify the user's actual project roots.
errors.root_cause: Historical local drive layout was embedded in a portable acceptance gate.
errors.fix: Removed fixed roots and made canary discovery consume the explicit path-list capability WORKLAB_CANARY_PROJECT_ROOTS; absent capability remains PENDING.
errors.repeat_prevention: Portable gates must never guess a user's drive, home, installation, project root or executable path.
errors.remaining_boundary: This runner has no declared real OS project root, so the canary remains environment-limited PENDING.

errors.observed_error: The tracked user profile contained nearly complete client configs, provider/model values, environment key names, Skill inventories and absolute workstation paths.
errors.root_cause: Secret redaction was treated as sufficient for a portable user overlay, so machine-private and officially owned state was copied into Git.
errors.fix: Replaced the snapshot with a v2 field-allowlisted overlay, excluded private/runtime state entirely, used capability-discovered roots and made export plan-only unless --write is explicit.
errors.repeat_prevention: Tracked user overlays must contain only fields marked MANAGE by the ownership authority and must never persist absolute paths or full native client configuration.
errors.remaining_boundary: No live user profile was changed; approved field application still requires client-native backup, diff, readback and rollback.

errors.observed_error: Observer projection paths embedded concrete model identities and dated provider prices, trusted a manually assigned stale flag, and initialized missing governance sources as zero.
errors.root_cause: Historical test fixture pricing and display defaults were promoted into production projection logic instead of being supplied as observed canonical facts.
errors.fix: Removed embedded models and prices, required caller-supplied provenance and validity intervals, computed expiry from time evidence, kept absent/invalid/partial pricing without a USD total, and left missing governance counts null.
errors.regression_test: python tests/test_usage_rollup.py and python scripts/verify_usage_rollup.py and python tests/test_observer_runtime.py
errors.repeat_prevention: Observer must never own provider pricing or hardcode a replaceable model/version; every estimate must require fresh Workflow canonical evidence.
errors.remaining_boundary: No live vendor pricing collector was run, so real prices remain unknown until Workflow records approved observations.

errors.observed_error: Active-project detection returned empty ACTIVE list: Windows process table (tasklist/wmic) exposes executable paths but not process working directory, so project activity could not be inferred from process cwd.
errors.root_cause: Windows does not expose process cwd via tasklist/wmic; executable path is unrelated to the project being worked on; first implementation relied on it.
errors.fix: Replaced cwd inference with per-project agent evidence freshness (project-local .hermes/.codex/.agents mtimes within 120 min) gated by agent process actually running.
errors.repeat_prevention: Active-project detection must combine running-agent check with per-project evidence freshness; never fabricate activity from executable path alone.
errors.remaining_boundary: Freshness window is a heuristic; a project open in an editor without agent writes is not marked active.

errors.observed_error: Observer dashboard API returned projects without the frontend `state` field; web renderer read p.state (running/idle/...) while API sent p.status (ACTIVE/REGISTERED), so the UI rendered all zeros / empty tables.
errors.root_cause: Frontend render contract (R2 visual assets era) and canonical projection schema drifted: field names and value vocabularies diverged.
errors.fix: observer_canonical now emits `state` (mapped from canonical status via _dashboard_project_state) plus agentPlatform/ciState; usage projection emits inputTokens/outputTokens/series from canonical samples.
errors.repeat_prevention: Any dashboard/API schema change must be verified end-to-end in a live browser against real canonical data before delivery.
errors.remaining_boundary: Freshness label semantics (STALE in LIVE mode) still snapshot-oriented.

errors.observed_error: Python server-rendered dashboard read the retired event-rebuild schema (overview/tasks/dataQuality) so it rendered '暂无观测事件' even when canonical store had real projects/tasks/usage/ci.
errors.root_cause: _render_full/_render_compact still consumed the legacy ObserverStore projection shape while data source was switched to canonical to_dashboard().
errors.fix: Rewrote both renderers against the canonical to_dashboard() schema: project table (name/state/id), usage tokens, quality integrity, CI runs.
errors.repeat_prevention: Server-rendered debug dashboard must be contract-tested against the canonical projection shape, not legacy event store.
errors.remaining_boundary: Python dashboard is a debug-compat entry; official UI remains web/ + Tauri.

errors.observed_error: Native build failed: tauri 2.11.3 dependency graph (idna_adapter 1.2.2, time-macros 0.2.32) uses edition2024, unsupported by contract rust 1.77.2; cargo 1.77 resolver selects these versions and compilation aborts.
errors.root_cause: Contract rust 1.77.2 predates edition2024 stabilization (cargo >= 1.85); tauri 2.11.x released 2025 requires newer rustc (up to 1.88 for plist/time).
errors.fix: Upgraded toolchain to rustc 1.88.0 (user-approved, D:\All projects\OS Environment\.rustup), kept tauri 2.11.3 contract versions, rebuilt EXE + MSI + NSIS.
errors.repeat_prevention: Native toolchain contract must track the dependency graph's minimum rustc; document rustc >= 1.88 for tauri 2.11.x on the contract.
errors.remaining_boundary: Contract doc still says 1.77.2 (lower bound only); actual build requires 1.88.

errors.observed_error: observer_api_is_loopback_get_only failed for IPv6 loopback: url crate host_str() returns '[::1]' with brackets, so parse::<IpAddr>() failed and validated_observer_api returned None.
errors.root_cause: host_str() keeps IPv6 brackets; bracket-wrapped host is not a valid bare IpAddr literal.
errors.fix: Use url.host() typed Host::Ipv4/Ipv6 instead of host_str(); added url crate dep; verified via cargo test 1/1 and EXE window launch.
errors.repeat_prevention: IPv6 loopback validation must use typed host() not host_str(); keep an IPv6 test case.
errors.remaining_boundary: None (fixed and verified).

errors.observed_error: PR #52 exact-SHA CI: integration + workflow-assistance failed with CURRENT_STATE_FRESHNESS_FAIL source-digest-mismatch after committing code changes.
errors.root_cause: CURRENT_STATE.json was generated for the previous head; new commits changed the source digest.
errors.fix: Regenerated CURRENT_STATE for the committed head (digest fe0f68d3...) and pushed; CI then passed 5/5.
errors.repeat_prevention: Any PR touching tracked code must regenerate CURRENT_STATE before pushing; freshness check is part of integration gate.
errors.remaining_boundary: None.

errors.observed_error: Codex CLI launcher exited 126 (Permission denied) executing the WindowsApps OpenAI.Codex copy at app/resources/codex.exe after the Store package updated; the plugin copy hash no longer matched the Store copy, and the pinned non-versioned OpenAI/Codex/bin/codex.exe candidate did not exist.
errors.root_cause: bin/codex pinned a non-versioned OpenAI/Codex/bin/codex.exe candidate that does not exist (official CLI installs live under versioned subdirectories), and on Store/plugin hash mismatch it still queued the WindowsApps copy whose ACLs block Git Bash exec, aborting the whole wrapper.
errors.fix: bin/codex now globs OpenAI/Codex/bin/*/codex.exe (user-writable, bypasses WindowsApps ACLs) ahead of the Store/plugin pair, uses the plugin copy only on exact hash match, and exec failures (126) fall through to the next candidate instead of aborting.
errors.repeat_prevention: The launcher must keep multiple resolvable candidate paths and must never abort on a single exec ACL failure; every wrapper change must re-run the regression_test.
errors.remaining_boundary: Store package updates can still change the plugin hash; the versioned install covers the real CLI.

errors.observed_error: Observer dashboard rendered canonical freshness mode vocabulary (LIVE/STALE/SNAPSHOT) as raw text with the default gray tone because _quality_tone/_quality_cn only knew legacy dataQuality words (source-exact/partial/deduplicated); LIVE mode did not surface as fresh/green.
errors.root_cause: The canonical projection emits mode vocabulary while the dashboard renderer expects the frontend freshness vocabulary (fresh/stale/offline); the two vocabularies drifted apart after the canonical-schema dashboard rewrite.
errors.fix: Added _freshness_state() mapping LIVE->fresh, STALE/SNAPSHOT->stale, OFFLINE->offline, UNKNOWN->unknown; extended _quality_tone/_quality_cn with fresh/stale/offline labels and colors; _render_full/_render_compact now render through the mapping.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every dashboard vocabulary mapping must be covered by a render regression test, and canonical mode words must never leak into the dashboard HTML.
errors.remaining_boundary: Observer is read-only; projection vocabulary is a rendering concern, the canonical mode enum is unchanged.
